findings.location: task.hints[2].blocks[0].text and task.feedback.incorrectUk: “ustedes (ввічливе «Ви» до кількох людей)”
findings.description: The Ukrainian explanation uses uppercase «Ви» explicitly for multiple addressees. Respectful capitalization of Ukrainian Ви applies to addressing one specific person; plural address takes lowercase ви. The answer key and the transcript translation are otherwise correct.
findings.suggestion: In both fields, replace “ustedes (ввічливе «Ви» до кількох людей)” with “ustedes (формальне «ви» до кількох людей)”.

sources: Course contract rule 8: learner-facing Ukrainian, including terminology and orthography, must be correct.
Український правопис (2019), capitalization rule for Ви and Ваш when respectfully addressing one specific person (from memory).
